analysis.summary: This paper proposes a black-box methodology for testing data-centric systems, motivated by the observation that existing methods suffer from ineffective oracles, insufficient coverage and inefficient test generation. Its key idea is to build the test case incrementally and use the intermediate results to construct a reference case, whose result must match the original's. Applied to Datalog engines and DBMSs it uncovered 75 unique bugs.
